activity_summary: At nine, and not before, you rehearsed at the Cross Keys. Garnish had Thursday's two stops in the book. Nick had walked the speech and did not speak it out. Phillips sent him to eat. You walked the old book for the Seven Deadly Sins. Kemp was civil. You did not open a tally, and you did not quote the new play. The gown's fifty shillings stayed unpaid, and this room did not settle them. Nothing was bought. The new comedy stayed off the yard.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a third stop and kept the new comedy off the yard.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Asked for the old cues and left the seventeen days where they were.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Stayed civil and stayed out of a scene that was not this morning's.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Held the songs and sent Nick to eat.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Showed the two stops in the book and kept the plot to the old one.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Reported the breath, did not speak the speech, and went to eat.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: The two stops from Thursday are in the book, where you crossed the roll.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: We are civil this morning, Will, and I intend to remain so.
